title: TESS pixels and Gaia DR3 epochs put all 7 non-TOI Gaia DR3 transit candidates on target; 4 stay planet candidates (1.2-1.7 RJ) and 3 are eclipsing binaries
abstract: Question: Are the seven non-TOI planet-like TESS signals from the Gaia DR3 transit table (found by three earlier campaign studies) planets on the target stars, or eclipsing binaries or blends? Method: We made our own TESScut photometry of all 34 TESS sectors (2019-2025) with a Gaia scene model and fitted the transits with MCMC. We used the Gaia DR3 G epochs of 2014-2017 as an on-target depth and dilution calibrator. We did a difference-image source test in each sector against every Gaia star that can cause the dip. We compared the Gaia DR3 radial-velocity epoch scatter with reference stars, searched for secondary eclipses with red-noise errors and a split-sample replication test, used ZTF for the two northern stars, and ran TRICERATOPS. Results: In all 34 sectors the target is the best source of the dip; other Gaia stars fit worse by delta chi-square 139-2393. Three signals are eclipsing binaries: TIC 435052739 (Gaia RV K 17.8-29.3 km/s, companion 0.12-0.20 solar masses, ellipsoidal signal 3.6 sigma), TIC 4638108 (secondary eclipse at phase 0.46, about 1700 ppm, found in 2019-2021 sectors and replicated in 2023-2025 sectors; grazing primary), and TIC 169468881 (Gaia RV-variable, companion radius 2.36 RJ). Four stay on-target planet candidates: TIC 87433458 (1.6155 d, 1.75 RJ, Gaia RV mass < 18 MJ, TRICERATOPS FPP < 1e-6), TIC 93622019 (2.1239 d, 1.50 RJ, < 73 MJ, TRICERATOPS FPP 0.048), TIC 445886244 (1.4742 d, 1.21 RJ, transit density equals Gaia density, FPP 0.13) and TIC 44997521 (3.5494 d, 1.17 RJ, FPP 0.0011). In crowded fields a Gaussian-PSF scene model mis-estimated dilution by up to 1.6 times; Gaia epoch depths corrected this. Limitations: no spectroscopy or high-resolution imaging; no Gaia RV information for three stars; RV limits come from one summary value per star; unresolved companions within about 1 arcsec remain possible. The candidates need RV follow-up.
